name: CoNLL-2013 Shared Task on Grammatical Error Correction
description: The CoNLL-2013 shared task was devoted to grammatical error correction. In this paper, we give the task definition, present the data sets, and describe the evaluation metric and scorer used in the shared task. We also give an overview of the various approaches adopted by the participating teams, and present the evaluation results.
reputation: A classic shared-task benchmark that has been widely used in grammatical error correction research and evaluation.
notes: Standard GEC benchmark with scorer-specific evaluation; older benchmark and not directly comparable to modern LLM tasks without careful setup.
